name: Election Process in India
overview: General Elections are conducted for every 5 years at national/state level. To conduct and monitor elections in every constituency, an officer is appointed. saq.question: Explain Commission and Democracy with reference to Election Process in India.
saq.answer: Election Process in India Why are elections necessary in the democracy ? In this lesson we would learn about the set up and mechanism to conduct elections, what powers that set up has and what measures it takes from time to time. We even analyse the democratic, smooth and fair manner in which the elections are conducted. We assess the role of Election Commission in conducting the elections and discuss the reforms that are suitable to the present day situation to improve the prestige of Democracy.

saq.question: Explain Commission and Elections with reference to Election Process in India.
saq.answer: During the British rule, only 14% of the population had right to vote in the elections. At the time of first General Elections in 1952, there were 17.32 crore voters. At present, the number of voters is above 67 crores. For such a country, the Election Commission conducts elections with the help of about 45 lakh staff.
